name: RPG Walk Test
description: Integration test of the rpg mod on the rpg_demo game: real WASD/E key events walk the hero, collide, read a sign, turn an NPC, go through a door teleport, flip events by a story flag, fight a battle that returns to the same cell with the win flag set. Activated by --itest=rpg_walk with --game=rpg_demo --new; --shots=<dir> saves screenshots (windowed runs only).
